name: musica
description: A DJ booth and a pattern studio in one browser tab. Two decks with beatmatch, EQ, filters and loops; a step sequencer and piano roll in the FL Studio idiom; and a Spotify search panel for planning a set. Every sample is decoded and mixed client-side through Web Audio — the module serves the console and answers the Spotify half from your own API keys.
